يستنجب (form X)

# يُسْتَنْجَبُ (yustanjabu) /jus.tan.d͡ʒa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# يَسْتَنْجِبَ (yastanjiba) /jas.tan.d͡ʒi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
